title: Coordinator dispatch receipt
description: Durable audit record of one dispatch attempt. Canonical doc for the receipt shape; reconcile.mjs implements the checked subset (types/enums/patterns) plus cross-field stage invariants in code.

attempt_id.description: Minted ONCE at reservation. Never re-minted after a LAUNCH_UNKNOWN retry — retries reuse it via the Idempotency-Key.

authorization_ref.description: Approved contract reference the dispatch is authorized against. Free text is REJECTED — only real Linear issue refs (SHU-NNNN) or seeded FIXTURE refs.

stage.description: RESERVED is persisted BEFORE any launch is sent. Timeout alone never changes stage and never releases the slot.

requested_worker.description: Worker FAMILY requested (distinct from worker_identity, which is the actual session/run identity once one exists).

worker_identity.description: Actual worker session/run identity. MUST be null at RESERVED and LAUNCH_UNKNOWN (and at a pre-acceptance FAILED); MUST be set together with external_run_id once a run exists.

target_sha.description: Head SHA the dispatch is bound to. A PASS against any other SHA is stale and never satisfies this receipt.

external_run_id.description: Adapter run id (apirun_...) stored IMMEDIATELY once the API accepts the run. null at RESERVED/LAUNCH_UNKNOWN and when the trigger was refused before acceptance (quota/access).

adapter_status.description: Granular upstream adapter status preserved verbatim (queued|in_progress|suspended|completed|failed). null before a run exists.

evidence_links.description: Validated callback evidence links (GitHub PR / Linear comment) whose attempt_id and target_sha were checked before COMPLETED.

notes.description: Append-only audit trail: error codes, pause events, retry notes, hold reasons.

allOf.description: Per-stage run-identity invariants. RUNNING/COMPLETED/HOLD imply an accepted run (run id + worker identity + granular adapter status). FAILED may describe either a post-acceptance run failure (run fields set) or a trigger refused before acceptance — quota/access wall — in which case all three stay null.

anyOf.description: Pre-acceptance rejection (trigger refused: quota/access/4xx) — no run ever existed.

allOf.description: RESERVED must not carry launch/heartbeat/terminal timestamps; LAUNCH_UNKNOWN carries the launch timestamp only.
